text: Ну, здравствуй, солнышко. Садись, сыграем в дурачка.
instruct: Elderly Russian grandmother, about 75 years old, with a low, deep, velvety alto voice. Languid and drawling, unhurried, slightly lazy and sultry manner of speaking, with long soft vowels. A light natural huskiness and gentle rasp in the voice. Warm, sly and affectionate.
